name: RSI mean reversion in chop
description: Fades RSI extremes when the market is choppy (CHOP high, ADX low).

name: Money-flow confirmation
description: Trend entries only when Chaikin money flow and MFI confirm buying or selling pressure.
entry_long: cmf_value > 0.1 and mfi_value > 55 and close > ema_value
entry_short: cmf_value < -0.1 and mfi_value < 45 and close < ema_value
